formula: INTERACTION: logit(p)=alpha+betaP*zP+betaD*zD+betaC*zC+gammaPD*zPD+gammaPC*zPC. PRICE-only removes undefined/constant legacy CORE/MOBILE role; exactly6 coefficients. PVR control: alpha+betaP*zP. Constant comparator: p0=mean(y) on exact same training rows.
scaling: Training-only median and IQR/1.349 for P,D,C; clip main z to +/-5; standardize products zP*zD,zP*zC again by training median/IQR1.349 and clip5. Nonpositive/nonfinite scale fails month, no rescue.
penalty: Summed Bernoulli NLL +0.5*(4*sum(main slopes^2)+16*sum(interaction slopes^2)); intercept unpenalized. PVR-only slope penalty4. No class weighting, tuning, parameter scan or threshold search.
